secret_contract.aad: canonical UTF8 tuple [cbn.channels.v2,InstitutionId,owner_type,owner_uuid,Kind,VersionNo,KeyVersion]; UUIDs canonical lowercase
secret_contract.one_time_lost_response: status metadata then explicit rotation; never redisplay stored plaintext
secret_contract.rotation: staged version -> verify -> activate atomically and retire prior; audit; bounded webhook overlap only; missing key fails closed; pin ClientSecretId/VersionNo in OAuthSession, bump parent Application version and cancel pending/ready sessions atomically; in-flight exchange becomes reconcile-only
secret_contract.legacy_transition: decrypt with verified old key and re-encrypt per explicit integration+kind mapping; keep original bytes. Missing key/ambiguous mapping blocks, no plaintext/Fernet/JWT fallback.
secret_contract.generated_signature_secret: endpoint_hmac is an explicitly configured bridge/endpoint signature secret, never a locally generated Meta App Secret/TikTok Client Secret. Direct-provider signature uses its pinned provider application secret. No profile/key fallback.
secret_contract.canonical_meta_secret: Meta App Secret/Instagram App Secret/Facebook App Secret labels bind one exact meta_app_secret kind of the explicitly chosen Meta application/issuer profile. Legacy alias kinds are imported explicitly; never try other profiles/keys as a fallback.

oauth_contract.stored_state: SHA256 of random state; no raw state/code in DB or logs
oauth_contract.pkce: S256 when supported by reviewed provider profile; no unverified assumption of provider support or silent downgrade
oauth_contract.unsupported_pkce: confidential client with server secret + state/session binding and separate reviewed issuer/callback; require provider-specific security acceptance before activation
oauth_contract.claim: single conditional UPDATE pending+notexpired+matchingbinding -> exchanging with ClaimId; commit durable intent before HTTP exchange
oauth_contract.refresh: serialize per IntegrationId; optimistic pinned secret version; token rotation atomic; omit new refresh token preserves verified prior; unknown outcome requires reconciliation/re-auth, not blind retry
oauth_contract.configuration_merge: merge only provider-owned returned fields; preserve policy/scopes/operator notes; never wholesale config replacement
oauth_contract.callback: new public composition, exact HTTPS redirect and issuer; authenticate browser binding, sanitize query, no-store/no-referrer; never weaken C9 LocalAiGuard
oauth_contract.asset_selection: state/code claimed once; actor/session/app-bound expiring grant may connect several explicitly selected IG/FB assets using one ProviderOperation per asset+channel. create_connections scope allocates/reuses exact authorized target IntegrationId; bound_connection cannot escape its pinned target. Preserve immutable snapshots and asset-owned provisional tokens; no global catalog authority.
oauth_contract.secret_pin: exact app secret row/kind/version pinned; no IG/FB/Meta fallback. Rotation invalidates pending sessions, never substitutes a different secret.
oauth_contract.grant_scope: creation grant bound to application+actor+browser+approved channels; existing-account grant additionally pins IntegrationId. Every connect rechecks actor role/scopes/snapshot/expiry and is idempotent by session+asset+target channel. Completing/cancelling/expiring closes the grant; never re-exchanges code.

routing_contract.selection: explicit IntegrationId on every private operation; default by channel allowed only if exactly one and explicit compatibility adapter; otherwise 409 ambiguous
routing_contract.whatsapp: one Integration per selected phone_number_id, multiple IntegrationIds per WABA/application allowed; original singleton inferred from UI corrected
routing_contract.endpoint: Application-owned endpoint with explicit EndpointIntegration routes; may serve many accounts; authenticate with pinned application/key before route parsing
routing_contract.event_key: versioned per-provider normalization; include event kind/state/occurred_at where delivery transitions share message id. Stable id absent -> deterministic receipt/subpath fallback marked weak and quarantined before irreversible effects
routing_contract.unknown_or_ambiguous: quarantine; never first/latest integration, body-selected institution, or global secret scan
routing_contract.provider_identifier_namespace: ExternalNamespace is a server-derived SHA256 of the reviewed provider identity namespace. App-scoped IDs such as TikTok Open ID include client application scope; global provider resource IDs use their reviewed resource namespace. Integration account uniqueness includes this namespace, never blindly merges bare external IDs.
routing_contract.identity_mutation: application/client/issuer/provider/asset identity with historical dependencies cannot be edited by blind PATCH; explicit new profile/mapping and controlled history-preserving rebind release required, otherwise409

webhook_contract.provider_profile_acceptance: signature algorithms/keys, URLs, scopes and versions must be checked against provider primary docs and real controlled fixtures before activation; no claim of provider acceptance in C10
webhook_contract.meta_no_timestamp: HMAC-authenticated durable replay dedupe; never invent provider timestamps
webhook_contract.durability: authenticate -> durable encrypted raw receipt -> ACK2xx; no CRM/AI/provider side effects before commit; ACK loss reconciles exact receipt key
webhook_contract.batch: normalize every entry/change/message/status/comment into separate event rows; preserve receipt/subpath linkage
webhook_contract.delete: soft deactivate, preserve audit/receipts/routes; no cascading history deletion
webhook_contract.retention: encrypted raw body default 7 days, institution-reviewed retention before operation; metadata tombstones prevent replay across policy window; no cleanup executed in C10
webhook_contract.raw_body_aad: canonical UTF8 [cbn.receipt.v1,InstitutionId,EndpointId,ReceiptId,Digest,BodyKeyVersion]; raw-body and credential key domains separated
webhook_contract.authentication_provenance: pin SignatureSecretId, VersionNo via immutable secret row, EndpointVersion, signature profile and verified timestamp; AES key version alone is not the provider-secret identity
webhook_contract.purge: terminal/unleased raw body only -> NULL body fields with BodyPurgedAt; keep receipt ID, endpoint, digest and authentication tombstone for replay policy; never purge queued/uncertain work
webhook_contract.bridge_profile: explicit trusted bridge only, no inferred direct-provider authenticity; exact key, timestamp and body scheme must be reviewed before enabling; bridge evidence never silently substitutes signed direct-provider evidence

tiktok_contract.quota_zero: unlimited exactly as source, never an activation flag
tiktok_contract.quota_atomicity: UPDLOCK,HOLDLOCK bucket by IntegrationId+UTC day+action; reserve and enqueue atomically; unique operation/action; count comments in outbound budget and AI separately; uncertain retains reservation; every real dispatch needs a reservation linked to same integration AND operation; shared outbound bucket for chats/comments, separate ai bucket; no release of unknown outcomes
tiktok_contract.rollout: stable HMAC bucket of IntegrationId+subject+policy version; retries do not reroll
tiktok_contract.egress: HTTPS exact hosts and relative paths from reviewed server profiles; reject credentials/query/fragment/IP/private-address/redirect tricks; token aliases preinstalled allowlist bound to institution+integration, no arbitrary os.getenv
tiktok_contract.policy_edit: all source fields preserved; no review/payload checkbox alone grants real permissions
